title: An Innovative Modular Multilevel Converter Topology Suitable for a Wide Power Range
version: Author-posted paper from IEEE Bologna Power Tech Conference Proceedings (2003), vol. 3, DOI 10.1109/PTC.2003.1304403

passages.locator: Abstract; sections II.A and IV; Fig. 1
passages.note: The authors set out series submodules with local storage capacitors for high-voltage converters and report simulation results for a 36 MW intertie. The study does not report a 36 MW operating link.
